label: 2004_data2
name: data2
advice: The virgil fit has broken up into a chain of dots. This is indicating a problem with regularization perhaps. The real data consist of a dot (which we correctly recover) at about (5, 0), and a large faint ellipse (broken up into a chain of dots in our recovery) with a small circle overlapping its edge. Consider TV as an optimal regularizer for this sort of piecewise constant data, and whether the smaller dots should be point sources.
